text:
sara_csm: Heads up — SoleraTech onboarding showing p95 spikes around peak traffic. Dashboard shows p95 ~980ms vs baseline 720ms. Renewal in ~39d. Thinking a measured model swap + int8 quant canary and a short routing hedge to dedicated-usw during peak. Thoughts?

devon_eng: Do we have seq length distribution and whether they're on hosted or dedicated? Also any recent infra changes?

sara_csm: They're on hosted. Seq len median ~120, 95th ~410. Mostly small chat-ish requests but bursts every 5–10s. No infra changes on their side. Link to traces: https://redwood.app/trace/solera/abc123

mika_ml: OK. For that distribution compact-1 (smaller LLM) + int8 often reduces p95 without big quality impact. Recommend 10% canary to compact-1-int8 + run the eval suite (50 golden prompts) for regressions. If quality delta >0.8% flag rollback.

cho_runtime: We can implement routing hedge: prefer dedicated-usw-1 during 13:00–16:00 UTC and fall back to hosted. Also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts to cut tail latency. Sample routing snippet I can push to the policy service: ```json
{
  "name": "solera-latency-hedge-2026-03",
  "schedule": {"start":"13:00","end":"16:00","tz":"UTC"},
  "route_preference": ["dedicated-usw-1","hosted"],
  "canary": {"model":"compact-1-int8","traffic_pct":10},
  "rollback_quality_threshold_pct": 0.5
}
```

devon_eng: I'll run the eval job and include token-level latency breakdown + 50 golden prompts. Will set the A/B to 10% traffic and monitor p95/token-rate and top error buckets.

ops-bot: eval job queued by devon_eng (job id 4761). ETA ~45m.

devon_eng: Quick update — eval finished. compact-1-int8 10% canary -> p95 down from 980ms to 870ms on canary traffic. Quality delta on golden set: 0.45% net metric (below our 0.5% soft threshold), but two prompts show hallucination increase; creating a short prompt guard for those.

sara_csm: Nice. I'll draft the customer note: explain canary + expected latency gains and offer rollback if they see quality issues. Planning canary start Tue 09:00 PT. @account-manager can you confirm scheduling and customer comms?

account-manager: Confirmed — I'll own the customer communication and set the renewal playbook note. Thanks team.

cho_runtime: I'll push the routing policy as a staged change and keep automatic rollback if quality threshold exceeded. Will also enable KV prefix cache for the tenant.

sara_csm: Great — closing loop. Will collect customer feedback during the canary window and report back here. :thumbsup:
